{{Quote|I will take what Jedi we have left and go to Geonosis and help Obi-Wan.|Mace Windu|audio=Windu-WhatJedi.flac|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
'''Tarados Gon''' was a [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Gon was apart of a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|Jedi strike team]] that had the objective of rescuing the Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].   The Klatooinian stormed into the [[Petranaki arena|arena]] where they were held and fought against the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist forces]] there. After the Jedi were surrounded by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|forces]], they were saved by the arrival of [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and the clone troopers with him. Gon [[Death/Legends|perished]] soon after when the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport]] he traveled in was destroyed. 

==Biography==
{{Quote|Master Windu. You have fought gallantly&hellip;worthy of recognition in the archives of the Jedi Order. Now, it is finished. Surrender, and your lives will be spared."''<br />''"We will not be hostages to be bartered, Dooku."''<br />''"Then, I'm sorry old friend.|Dooku offers Gon and the other Jedi a chance to surrender, which is refused by Mace Windu|audio=DookuAndWindu-Surrender.flac|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Tarados Gon, a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], was part of<ref name="AOTC" /> the 200-strong<ref name="Jedi Casualties">{{Blog|holocron|10|Jedi Casualties: Battle of Geonosis}}</ref> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi assault team/Legends|strike team]] led by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to rescue Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]],<ref name="AOTC" /> who were held by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in the [[Petranaki arena]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="Inside" /> After Windu revealed the Jedi presence at the arena,<ref name="AOTC" /> Gon stormed in to engage the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] and the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Warrior caste (Geonosian)/Legends|warriors]] there.<ref name="Legacy Collection" /> 

[[File:Saesee_Tiin_Geonosis.png|thumb|right|350px|Tarados Gon (right) huddled in a survivor circle in the Petranaki arena.]]
Eventually, the Jedi were overwhelmed, and survivors huddled into a ring at the center of the arena. Windu and Separatist [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] debated the surrender of the Jedi. The Jedi Master refused surrender, leading the count to order their [[Death/Legends|death]]. Before the surrounding [[Droid/Legends|droids]] could enact the order,<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]]<ref name="Yoda">{{SWE|characters|yoda|Yoda}}</ref> [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] arrived with the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] collected the Jedi and flew them out of the arena.<ref name="AOTC" />

As the gunship Gon was on, alongside Jedi [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]] and [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]], flew away from the arena,<ref name="Inside" /> the ship was directly hit and went down in [[Fire/Legends|flames]].<ref name="AOTC" /> Gon was killed,<ref name="Inside" /> but Bulq and Koth were able to survive the crash.<ref name="Jedi Casualties" />

==Personality and traits==
Tarados Gon was a [[Color/Legends|brown]]-skinned [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]].<ref name="Legacy Collection /> The Jedi had three-digit hands;<ref name="AOTC" /> other members of his [[Species/Legends|species]] possessed five digits.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Equipment==
Gon armed himself with a blue-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] with a silver hilt. On Geonosis, he wore a tan [[Clothing/Legends|undershirt]], a light-colored [[Jedi apparel/Legends|tunic]], a brown [[Belt/Legends|belt]], tan pants, and brown [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="Legacy Collection" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TiinGonHandshake-SkywalkerSaga.png|thumb|right|200px|Tarados Gon and Saesee Tiin shake hands in a deleted scene.]]
Tarados Gon appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AOTC" /> in scenes filmed at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] from [[August 10]] to [[August 15]], [[2000]].<ref name="Archives">''[[The Star Wars Archives: Episodes I–III, 1999–2005]]''</ref> The character was first revealed<ref name="WebDoc">{{SW|url=/video/good-to-g-o|series=Making Episode II Webdocs|text=Part 10: Good to G.O.}}</ref> on [[February 26]], [[2002]]<ref name="Archive">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/me2/archive.html|text=''Making Episode II Webdocs'' archive}}</ref> with the release of the web documentary "[[Making Episode II Webdocs|Good to G.O.]],"<ref name="WebDoc" /> and later made his first appearance in the [[Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones 4|fourth issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones (comic series)|comic book adaptation]] of Episode II, written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and illustrated by [[Jan Duursema]].<ref name="AOTCComic">[[Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones 4|''Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones'' 4]]</ref> The issue was published on [[May 8]], 2002,<ref name="ComicDate">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/00-477/Star-Wars-Episode-II----Attack-of-the-Clones-4|text=Star Wars: Episode II -- Attack of the Clones #4}}</ref> ahead of Episode II's release date on [[May 16]] of that year.<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> Gon's name was first revealed through the [[StarWars.com]] "Ask the Jedi Council" feature on [[September 3]], 2002.<ref name="Ask the Jedi Council">{{SWArchive|url=community/askjc/jocasta/askjc20020903.html|text=Ask the Lucasfilm Jedi Council: Jedi in the Arena?}}</ref>

Gon is depicted with a blue lightsaber throughout most of the Geonosis battle sequence. However, the color of Gon's lightsaber changes to green when Mace Windu declines Count Dooku's surrender offer, and when the Assault Transports land.<ref name="AOTC" /> Originally, the circumstances of the Jedi survivor circle differed from what appeared in the final film. The Jedi [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] deactivate the battle droids from a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|control ship]], allowing the Jedi in the Petranaki arena to huddle. As they did so, Gon gave fellow Jedi [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] a hand shake.<ref name="Complete Saga">{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga|scene=Raid on the Droid Control Ship}}</ref>
